international.title: US senators urge White House AI chief to fix vulnerabilities after mass outages
international.summary: As Democrats flag AI bank breaches and cyber-attacks in Japan, Jay Clayton says system failures happen US politics live – latest updates A bipartisan pair of US senators are calling on Jay Clayton, the director of national intelligence and AI czar, to identify and fix vulnerabilities in the US’s infrastructure following nationwide outages at major companies and government agencies. Maria Cantwell, the top Democrat on the Senate commerce, science, and transportation committee, and Mike Rounds, the Republican chair of the Senate subcommittee on cybersecurity, sent a letter to Clayton on Tuesday, outlining concerns sparked by reports of AI accessing major banks, cyber-attacks in Japan and more.
